scope: Static original binary/PDB and original source. No allocation, actor activation or original runtime observations are claimed by this report.

on_spawn_registration.bounded_source_search: All 99 original Content/Scripts/*.lua regular files, exact OnSpawn identifier.
on_spawn_registration.matching: The directly registered RunManager callback has no source string or ID filter, so it applies to every native OnSpawn dispatched after the original definition/caller gates.
on_spawn_registration.obstacle_branch: If ObstacleData[name] exists, wait(0.01) yields BEFORE setup, then DeepCopyTable and SetupObstacle(obstacle,true) use triggeredById. This scheduling is intentional in the original source.
on_spawn_registration.enemy_branch: Only when no obstacleData and NeedsLuaInitialization is true and EnemyData[name] exists: copy enemy data, set ObjectId, SetupEnemyObject, optionally associate SpawnedById.
on_spawn_registration.OnLoad_source_search: No exact OnLoad identifier found in the same source directory; native support/order remains reconstructed because registrations can be introduced by additional script content.

source_filter_native.empty: No numeric source IDs and no names => true.
source_filter_native.numeric: A numeric source filter compares against Thing.pMapThing->mDef.Id (Thing+0x240 points to MapThing, ID at+0x28). Dynamic mapless actors have no map source ID for this check.
source_filter_native.names: OR membership across exact group membership, category _UNIT for virtual category2, category _OBSTACLE for virtual category1, or exact virtual GetName string.
source_filter_native.case: String equality is case-sensitive in the examined byte comparisons.
source_filter_native.sourceVsRuntime: Map source identity, runtime Thing.mId, type-name and native category are distinct concepts even where map-backed mId equals source ID.

trigger_args.allocation: Fresh Lua::NewTable(Script::TRIGGER_ARGS_TABLE_NAME/global_triggerArgs) for each matching OnSpawn callback at0x1802893a8. Keep that actual table alive across coroutine yield; later replacing the global must not overwrite its contents.

all_spawn_callbacks.name: Thing virtual GetName atvtable+0x88, passed through Script::run.
all_spawn_callbacks.triggeredById: Thing.mId+0x6c, sign-extended int64, set by Script::run.
all_spawn_callbacks.TriggeredByTable: Actual attached Thing Lua table at+0x150; LuaTable::Set<LuaTable> pushes nil for an invalid table, otherwise retains original registry table identity. Do not fabricate a new table or copy owner values.

units_only.SpawnedById: Unit.mSpawnedBy+0x3c8 always written for a unit, including default0.
units_only.PlayerIndex: Only if Unit.pPlayer+0x3b0 exists; value from Player+8. Do not infer player ownership from PlayerControlled alone before association actually exists.

trigger_args.load_callbacks: Source Thing is null. Fresh args contains nonempty map name as name. No triggeredById/TriggeredByTable or spawn-only fields.

initial_map_unit_flags.enemy: World::CreateThing sets the seventh CreateEnemyUnit argument false at0x1803130f3; CreateEnemyUnit reads it at0x1802fa4de and passes to Add. Thus this map-backed enemy path also sets NeedsLuaInitialization=false.
initial_map_unit_flags.flag_caution: World::CreateThing R9 fourth argument is retained to a DIFFERENT CreateEnemyUnit argument used by Unit::Init/start graphics. Do not equate it with NeedsLuaInitialization.
initial_map_unit_flags.order: UnitManager::Add registers the Thing with World::AddActiveMapThing at0x1802f9510 BEFORE tailcalling OnSpawn at0x1802f9524.
initial_map_unit_flags.obstacles: Previously recovered ObstacleManager::Add caller gate suppresses optional dispatch; when invoked it passes NeedsLuaInitialization=false.

order: incremental CreateMapThings including allowed OnSpawn initial resumes
subsequent world frames may resume yielded callbacks
world_start_order.MapBegin_source_filter: No mTriggerNames runs; otherwise exact map name must be in names list. Numeric source ID vector is not checked by Map::Begin.
world_start_order.world_activation: World::Start calls Map::Begin at0x18031112d; only success path0x1803114ab sets mRunning,0x1803114ae sets mFrame=1.
world_start_order.async_boundary: A successful callback initial resume or Map::Begin return does not mean waited work has completed. RunManager obstacle setup expressly resumes on a later world clock deadline.
world_start_order.failure: OnAnyLoad ProtectedRun failure aborts Map::Begin; native World::Start chooses error flow. Script::run also has HAS_CRASHED guard.

identity_allocation.map_backed: Thing::InitMapThing writes original MapThing ID+0x28 into Thing.mId+0x6c at0x1802dd3de/e1. Both Unit and Obstacle Init skip dynamic allocation when mId!=-1.
identity_allocation.mapless: InitMapThing(null) sets mId=-1. Unit::Init allocates only on that sentinel (CMP/JNE0x1802f0fd7/db), then ++World.mNextUnitId and writes mId0x1802f1006..100c. Obstacle mirrors this at0x1802c2e40/4a/75/7f.
identity_allocation.ctorVsReset: World constructor initially zeros both counters. Gameplay World::Reset sets unit counter1,000,000 at0x180315fac and obstacle counter2,000,000 at0x180315fb3; constructor zero is not the proper post-reset allocation baseline.
limits: These bounded allocator branches increment without a recovered wrap/collision repair check. PDB range constants do not establish overflow behavior.
Engine Entity generation/index handles remain separate from Thing.mId.
First generated ID assumes no earlier mapless allocation since the same reset; real callback creation order determines the next ID.

unknowns: Native overflow/exhaustion handling for dynamic ID ranges beyond the examined branch.
Full lifecycle code must preserve incremental creation/query visibility and component prerequisites; these static findings do not make the existing query proxies active actors.
Owner Lua table association timing for every player/enemy activation path must follow actual component association, not metadata alone.
